title: Exact Dicke-State Moments, Certified Single-Round Amplification, and Subquadratic Reversible Routing for Asymptotic Quantum Many-Body Scars
abstract: We resolve three quantitative and algorithmic gaps in the unified Dicke-state preparation protocol for exact and asymptotic quantum many-body scars (AQMBS) of Asari, Kunimi, and Nikuni (arXiv:2611.33987v1). First (Theorem A), we derive exact closed-form without-replacement rational formulas for the fourth and sixth moments of Z(l) on Dicke states |D_n^{M'}> across all four cosine power-sum resonance classes, proving uniformly for all M' >= 2, 1 <= n <= M'-1, and 1 <= l <= M'-1 that kappa_4 <= 3 (4x sharper than Asari et al.'s Hoeffding bound 12, with unique finite equality at (M',n,l)=(4,2,2)), kappa_6 < 15 (8x sharper than 120), and kappa_6 - kappa_4^2 < 6. Second (Theorem B), projecting sin(sX) onto the optimal linear multiple (1 - (kappa_4/6)s^2)sX yields the universal non-asymptotic infidelity bound 1 - F(s) <= s^4(4 + 3s^2)/(6(2 - s^2)^2) for all 0 < s < sqrt(2) and envelope s^2 - s^4 <= p_succ(s) <= s^2. At Asari et al.'s operating point s = 0.495, this improves the bare p_succ lower bound by 37.94x (to 0.18499), certifies single-round Grover amplification p_amp^(1) >= 0.94488 with zero overshoot uniformly over all (M',n,l) (21.8x above the prior bound), and sharpens uniform infidelity by 13.01x (to 0.01538); at s = 0.45, it certifies 1 - F <= 0.00975 < 0.01 uniformly with p_succ >= 0.16149 (25.84x above Eq. S11). Third (Theorem C), we construct a collision-free MSB-to-LSB binary-shift reversible routing circuit for both Onsager and DWC spacer-insertion maps Phi^{-1} using exactly B(BL - 2^B + 1) = O(M log^2 n) Stage-2 Fredkin gates plus at most B(2M' + 3L) = O(M log n) Stage-1/3 prefix-sum Toffoli gates with zero ancilla leakage, improving asymptotically by Theta(M/log^2 n) over the unpruned Theta(M^2) conveyor for all 3 <= n <= M'-2 and by Theta(n/log^2 n) over the pruned displacement benchmark 0.5*n*(2M'-n-1) whenever n = omega(log^2 n) (half-filling crossovers at M'=184 Stage-2 / M'=382 total 3Q gates, reaching 7.53x Stage-2 / 5.45x total 3Q reductions at M'=4096). All explicit six-partition formulas and eight branch polynomials for Theorem A(ii)-(iii) are included in Appendix A for standalone manuscript verification; the algebraic cores are constructively formalized in Lean 4.35.0 (18 theorems, 0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice, 0 warnings), backed by 16 SHA-256 exact rational certificates (QMBS-DICKE-SHARP-1.0) and an AST-audited zero-float verifier (53/53 tests passing).
